name: gliner2-base-v1
description: Zero-shot NER, relation extraction, and text classification with multi-task GLiNER2 architecture.

usage_examples.title: Extract entities
usage_examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8082/recognize \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "fastino/gliner2-base-v1", "texts": ["Steve Jobs founded Apple in Cupertino."], "labels": ["person", "organization", "location"]}'

usage_examples.title: Extract relations
usage_examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8082/recognize \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "fastino/gliner2-base-v1", "texts": ["Steve Jobs founded Apple."], "labels": ["founded by"], "task": "relations"}'

usage_examples.title: Classify text
usage_examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8082/classify \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "fastino/gliner2-base-v1", "texts": ["Apple reported record quarterly revenue."], "labels": ["finance", "technology", "sports"]}'
